The Life of the Prophetﷺ

Explore the lives of the Prophets, the Seerah of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and the legacy of his noble Companions through authentic, carefully selected books — in your own language.

Guidance from the Qur’an

Say, [O Muhammad], “If you should love Allah, then follow me, [so] Allah will love you and forgive you your sins.” And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

Ali ‘Imran · 3:31Translation: Sahih International

A Prophetic Reminder

“The strong person is not the one who wrestles others down; rather, the strong person is the one who controls himself when angry.”

Sahih al-Bukhari 6114 Sahih
Featured question · Seerah Why did Prophet Muhammad ﷺ marry Aisha (RA) at a young age?
Featured · Award-winning

Ar-Raheeq Al-Makhtum

Sheikh Safiur Rahman Mubarakpuri — The Sealed Nectar

Explore the life of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ through a clear, well-researched Seerah — from Makkah before revelation to the challenges of prophethood and the establishment of the Muslim community in Madinah. Presented in three eras, Ar-Raheeq Al-Makhtum brings the Prophet’s ﷺ journey, character, and mission into a readable and meaningful narrative.

Languages
28
Eras
3
Chapters
68
Lessons
459

Three periods of the Seerah

Pre-Prophethood Until 610 CE · up to age 40 Arabia before Islam, the Prophet’s ﷺ lineage and early life. Makki period 610–622 CE · age 40–53 Revelation, the call in Makkah, hardships and Hijrah. Madani period 622–632 CE · age 53–63 Madinan community, treaties, the conquest of Makkah and the farewell.
